text: ## Licenses **Font-GIS is licensed under [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/Viglino/font-gis/blob/main/LICENSE-APACHE.md)** Copyright (c) 2021 Jean-Marc Viglino [Font-GIS](https://viglino.github.io/font-gis/) is free, open source, and GPL friendly. You can use it for commercial projects, open source projects, or really almost whatever you want. Font-GIS files already contain embedded comments with sufficient attribution, so **you shouldn't need to do anything additional when using these files normally**.
